name: Nuanchan Sae-heng
bio:
Nuanchan's journey into motorsport catering was a happy accident. After years running a successful street food stall in Bangkok, she was approached by a team needing a reliable and inventive catering solution for a local race. Her blend of authentic Thai flavors and logistical efficiency impressed, leading to further opportunities. Now with Proton by Premotion, Nuanchan ensures the team is fueled with delicious, healthy meals, adapted to the rigorous demands of the racing calendar. 

Her approach is firm but fair. Nuanchan expects the best from her small kitchen team, pushing them to experiment with new dishes while maintaining the highest hygiene standards. She's a stickler for detail, meticulously planning menus to optimize energy levels and cater to any dietary requirements within the team. What sets Nuanchan apart is her commitment to using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, injecting a taste of Thailand into every meal, no matter where the team races.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a practical bun
physical.description: A petite woman with a permanent air of focused efficiency.

quirks: Always has a small bowl of fresh chilies on her desk.
Uses a complex spreadsheet to track everyone's dietary preferences.
Refers to the team as her 'children' and nags them about eating their vegetables.
